title: BPP snapshot_get request (DESIGN.md §14.4; registry R4 projection)
description: Read: never mutates, never carries meta (closed schema). Authorized snapshot read for the caller's scope (R4: authorized principal, Participant, or narrow projection service; closure E,P,O,D; opaque cursors). kinds and endeavor_ref are derived narrowing-only filter fields: filters can narrow visible events but never widen visibility (§14.4) — gap note G39.

kinds.description: Narrowing-only event-kind filter (§14.4); gap note G39.

endeavor_ref.description: Narrowing-only Endeavor filter (§14.4); gap note G39.

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z offset. DESIGN.md does not fix a timestamp wire encoding; this derivation freezes with the bundle (gap note G3).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.
